mentions.name: Digital Carrot
mentions.description: Digital Carrot is a cross-platform screen time app and app blocker that blocks distractions until programmable goals are met, such as blocking social media until you walk 10,000 steps, blocking Factorio until you go to the gym, or blocking Netflix until all Todoist goals are finished. Goals are verified with real data from sources like the phone's GPS and fitness trackers and can be programmed with a simple expression editor. Current work is streamlining the plugin and goal system so people can more easily write and share goals with one another.
